context.body: The mountain in three witnesses · Luke 9:28–36
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: About eight days after the sayings Jesus takes Peter, John, and James up the mountain to pray; his face changes and his clothing flashes white.
observations.label: Luke places prayer and an exodus conversation on the mountain: action

observations.body: Moses and Elijah speak of his departure to be completed at Jerusalem; sleepy disciples see glory, Peter proposes tents, a cloud brings fear, and the voice names the chosen Son.
observations.label: Luke places prayer and an exodus conversation on the mountain: response

observations.body: about eight days · pray · departure · glory · chosen Son · listen to him
observations.label: Words in Luke 9:28–36

payload.posture: Read Luke 9:28–36 as the mountain in three witnesses evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: “About eight days” stands beside Matthew and Mark’s “after six days” without an explicit counting explanation.
payload.title: Luke places prayer and an exodus conversation on the mountain
